mission: Mission Control — full-bleed fleet summary: machines running, host count, quick create, and per-namespace tone accents.
console: ConsoleHub — quick links into VNC/serial console sessions and day-2 actions for running VMs.
monitoring: Capacity headroom (free CPU/memory, node count, live-migration support) and installed KubeVirt/CDI platform versions.
topology: Cluster map as nodes and edges from the topology API.
vms: VirtualMachine inventory — create, start/stop/pause/restart, migrate, snapshot, clone, and inspect KubeVirt VMs.
hosts: Kubernetes node inventory — status, kernel, uptime, cordon/uncordon, reboot.
gpus: Per-node GPU inventory — passthrough/MIG/vGPU classification and allocatable counts.
images: ContainerDisk/ISO image catalog plus CDI DataSources, with publish/delete.
pods: Pod inventory across all namespaces, including virt-launcher pods, with logs and delete.
templates: Template Foundry — the built-in OS template catalog plus VMProfiles, with clone/delete.
pvcs: PersistentVolumeClaim inventory plus StorageClass/storage-pool summary, with resize/delete.
snapshots: VM disk snapshot inventory, with restore/delete.
atlas: Ceph-backed storage volumes and snapshots from the Atlas storage control-plane integration.
dr: Cluster backup and failback controls (Velero), dry-run friendly where the API allows.
alerts: Active Kubernetes/KubeVirt alerts and events, with resolve.
soc: Security detections surfaced by the SOC pipeline, with acknowledge.
settings: Console theme, self-healing policy, and integration status (PacketWolf, Atlas, SSO) for this deployment.
